# Lantern Circuit source material

The score, synthesis code and generated PCM in this foundation were created for
the Bugu project. There are no external samples, sound-library recordings, speech
recordings, downloaded assets or third-party compositions in these files.

This contribution uses the repository's existing MIT license in the root
`LICENSE`. The per-asset inventory repeats that file's existing project notice,
`Copyright (c) 2026 in dreaming`; it does not assert copyright registration,
third-party clearance or a separate licensing agreement. Retain the root license
and this notice when packaging these sources and their generated PCM. No new
outward distribution license is introduced by this foundation.

`assets.toml` records every generated asset's logical ID, score location,
generation command, license, notice, SHA-256, byte count, PCM format and inclusion
policy. Its paths are relative to the repository root. The `#` score location is
a descriptive reference to the named state or one-shot inside `assets/score.json`.

The dialogue state is an original musical underscore. It contains no person's
voice and is not represented as recorded or intelligible spoken dialogue.
